description: Enters or corrects data of a draft order: facts about the building (including facts.certificate_type to switch between 'verbrauch' and 'bedarf'), the heating, consumption periods as printed on the bills (for Verbrauchsausweis, in the bill's unit: kWh; m3 of gas with Brennwert and Zustandszahl; litres of oil; kg of pellets; we convert — always the whole building's Gesamtverbrauch, never one flat's share), or bedarf building/plant answers (for Bedarfsausweis: heating location, emitters, extensions, windows, PV/solar, etc. — no U-values or heating bills needed). Send only what you know: fields left out stay as they are, and consumption.periods or bedarf.windows replaces that list. Synonyms such as 'Gas' or 'heat pump' are accepted. Values are marked as entered by an assistant; the customer sees and confirms them before ordering. Returns the order, open points, and (for Bedarfsausweis) updated bedarf_questions and photo_tasks. Orders nothing.

attic_partly.description: if attic is unbeheizt but partly heated: approximate heated share in percent (25, 50, or 75; 0 if unknown)

basement_partly.description: if basement is unbeheizt but partly heated: approximate heated share in percent (25, 50, or 75; 0 if unknown)

buffer.description: for pellet/wood-chip boilers: true if a buffer tank (Pufferspeicher) stands next to the boiler

cooling_kind.description: when heating.cooling is strom: split, multisplit or waermepumpe

cooling_year.description: year the air conditioning was installed

electric_kind.description: for electric heating (strom_direkt): speicher (night-storage), direkt (convectors/infrared) or unbekannt

emitters.description: heat emitters: heizkoerper (radiators), fussbodenheizung (underfloor) or beides (both)

extensions.description: extensions or added storeys (Anbauten/Aufstockungen): keiner, einer or mehrere

floor_heating_share.description: when emitters is beides: percentage of heated area with underfloor heating (1–100)

generator_space.description: where the heating generator stands: keller, dach or wohnung

heater_count.description: for electric heating: approximate number of heaters

heater_fans.description: for night-storage heaters: true if they have fans

heaters.description: number of heating systems: eine (one), eine_ofen (one plus stove) or mehrere (multiple)

heating_output_kw.description: rated output of primary boiler in kW, if known from type plate

listed.description: true if the building is a listed monument (Denkmalschutz)

per_flat.description: true if each flat has its own heating system (Etagenheizung)

pool.description: true if there is an indoor swimming pool (sauna is false)

pv_modules.description: number of PV modules, if peak output is unknown

pv_peak_kwp.description: when heating.renewables includes photovoltaik: rated peak output in kWp

pv_side.description: roof orientation of PV modules: N, NO, O, SO, S, SW, W, NW or flach

radiators_under_windows.description: true if most radiators stand under the windows

roof_insulated.description: when attic is unbeheizt: true if the pitched roof above the loft is insulated

second_carrier.description: fuel of second boiler: erdgas, heizoel, fluessiggas, scheitholz, holzpellets or hackschnitzel

second_heating.description: when heaters is mehrere: kessel, holzkessel, waermepumpe or anderes

second_output_kw.description: rated output of second boiler in kW, if known from type plate

second_year.description: year the second heating system was installed

simple_shape.description: true if footprint is rectangular or L-shaped (only asked when 3D height was estimated)

solar_area_m2.description: solar thermal collector area in m², if known

solar_collector.description: solar collector type: flach (flat plate) or roehre (evacuated tube)

solar_panels.description: number of solar thermal collector panels, if known

solar_use.description: when heating.renewables includes solarthermie: warmwasser or heizung (water + heating)

solar_year.description: year solar thermal system was installed

store_space.description: where the hot-water tank stands: keller, dach, wohnung or keiner (no tank, e.g. Kombitherme)

store_with_generator.description: true if hot-water tank is in the same room as the heating generator

stove_kind.description: when heaters is eine_ofen: kaminofen, kachelofen, pelletofen or gasoel

stove_water_jacket.description: when heaters is eine_ofen: true if stove is connected to heating/hot water (Wassertasche)

ventilation_kind.description: when heating.ventilation is anlage_wrg: zentral, dezentral or einzelraeume

ventilation_space.description: when ventilation_kind is zentral: keller, dach or wohnung

ventilation_year.description: year the ventilation system was installed

windows.description: optional list of distinct window types (frame, glazing, year); replaces the list

frame.description: window frame material: kunststoff, holz or metall

glazing.description: window glazing: einfach, zweifach or dreifach

year.description: approximate year the windows were installed, 0 if unknown

periods.description: the billing periods of the whole building, one per period on the bill; from a Heizkostenabrechnung the Gesamtverbrauch der Liegenschaft, never one flat's share; replaces all periods

calorific_value.description: gas billed in m3 only: the Abrechnungsbrennwert (Hs) in kWh/m3 as printed; send it together with condition_factor

carrier.description: energy carrier billed, e.g. erdgas, heizoel, fernwaerme, holzpellets, strom_waermepumpe

condition_factor.description: gas billed in m3 only: the Zustandszahl as printed; send it together with calorific_value

end.description: last day of the billing period (inclusive), YYYY-MM-DD

evidence.description: the text you read this period from on the bill, verbatim, for the Energieberater

hot_water_kwh.description: only if the bill states the energy for hot water separately, in kWh

kwh_is_gross.description: for kWh of gas: true if the bill states kWh by the Brennwert (gas bills usually do; default true for gas)

quantity.description: consumption for heating and hot water in the period, as printed on the bill, as a plain number: German bills group thousands with a point, so 18.451 kWh is 18451

start.description: first day of the billing period, YYYY-MM-DD

unit.description: unit as printed: kWh, MWh, m3, l, kg, t, rm (Raummeter) or srm

vacancy_percent.description: share of the living area that stood empty in the periods, in percent

attic.description: beheizt (lived in, heated), unbeheizt (unheated loft) or keins (none, e.g. flat roof)

certificate_type.description: verbrauch (Verbrauchsausweis) or bedarf (Bedarfsausweis); switches the order's certificate type

living_area_m2.description: Wohnfläche of the whole building in m², all flats together

modernised.description: envelope parts renewed since construction: dach, aussenwand, fenster, kellerdecke; replaces the list

modernised_answer.description: explicit answer when modernised is empty: nichts (nothing renewed since built) or unbekannt (unknown)

ownership.description: gebaeude if the customer owns the whole building, wohnung if one flat in it; the certificate always covers the whole building

purpose.description: verkauf (sale), vermietung (letting), verlaengerung (lease extension) or aushang (display or own records)

residential_only.description: true if the building is used for housing only

storeys.description: full storeys (Vollgeschosse), without attic and basement

units.description: number of flats in the whole building

carrier.description: main energy carrier of the heating: erdgas, fluessiggas, heizoel, fernwaerme, holzpellets, scheitholz, hackschnitzel, strom_waermepumpe, strom_direkt, steinkohle or braunkohle

cooled_area_m2.description: living area cooled by air conditioning, in m²

cooling.description: keine, or strom for electric air conditioning

district_heating.description: with Fernwärme: how it is generated

generation.description: how the heat is made, as the supplier states: kwk_gas, kwk_kohle, kwk_erneuerbar (combined heat and power) or heizwerk_gas, heizwerk_kohle, heizwerk_erneuerbar (heating plant)

primary_factor.description: the Primärenergiefaktor the supplier publishes, if known

supplier.description: the Fernwärme supplier, e.g. Stadtwerke Münster

hot_water.description: zentral_enthalten (made by the heating, in its consumption, share unknown), zentral_gemessen (made by the heating, and the bill states the hot water share: send it as hot_water_kwh with each period) or dezentral (electric boilers or instantaneous heaters, not in the consumption)

hot_water_by.description: with hot_water zentral_enthalten and periods of several carriers: the carrier whose system heats the water, or gemeinsam when several heat it together (e.g. a wood stove with a water jacket and a heat pump on one tank). A room stove without a water jacket heats no water. Leave it out if unknown: the hot water is then split by consumption

renewables.description: solarthermie, photovoltaik, biomasse (wood stove); replaces the list. A heat pump or wood heating counts on its own

ventilation.description: fenster (windows), anlage (ventilation system) or anlage_wrg (with heat recovery)

year.description: Baujahr of the boiler or heat pump (with Fernwärme: of the transfer station), from the type plate or the chimney sweep's record

order_token.description: the order_token start_order returned; it opens only this order, keep it private

name: update_order

field.description: the update_order field name, e.g. bedarf.generator_space or bedarf.emitters

options.description: allowed values; omit for numbers or years

required.description: true if no default stands in and the user must answer it

hints.description: what looks odd without blocking, in German; check the values with the user

customer_can_add.description: true if the customer can add it on our page after the confirmation email

field.description: what to send, as the tools name it

frame.description: window frame material: kunststoff, holz or metall

glazing.description: window glazing: einfach, zweifach or dreifach

year.description: approximate year the windows were installed, 0 if unknown

sources.description: where each value came from: assistent (you), 3d (3D model), schaetzung (estimate), amtlich (cadastre), angabe (the customer)

generation.description: how the heat is made, as the supplier states: kwk_gas, kwk_kohle, kwk_erneuerbar (combined heat and power) or heizwerk_gas, heizwerk_kohle, heizwerk_erneuerbar (heating plant)

primary_factor.description: the Primärenergiefaktor the supplier publishes, if known

supplier.description: the Fernwärme supplier, e.g. Stadtwerke Münster

kind.description: document kind to pass to add_document, e.g. fassade, fenster, heizung

sector.description: for kind fassade: compass sector (N, NO, O, SO, S, SW, W, NW)
